name: handover-ai-backend

scripts.setup-dev: psql -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS handover_tool_db' -c 'CREATE DATABASE handover_tool_db' && psql -d handover_tool_db -f ./db/schema.sql -f ./db/migrations/003_add_ai_summary_cache.sql -f ./db/migrations/004_add_handover_voiding.sql -f ./db/migrations/005_add_password_hash.sql
scripts.setup-and-seed: npm run setup-dev && npm run seed
scripts.setup-test: psql -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS handover_tool_db_test' -c 'CREATE DATABASE handover_tool_db_test' && psql -d handover_tool_db_test -f ./db/schema.sql -f ./db/migrations/003_add_ai_summary_cache.sql -f ./db/migrations/004_add_handover_voiding.sql -f ./db/migrations/005_add_password_hash.sql

author: Davipol
description: Express API for Handover AI, a clinical shift handover tool
